nodes.title: Protected Student Data
nodes.info: The smaller, already-reviewed pile of data a club decided to save, now handled so only the right people can see it.

nodes.label: Limit Access
nodes.title: Limit Access
nodes.info: Only mentors and leaders who need the data get a login, not the entire volunteer roster. The risk closed: a departing volunteer who still has a working account.

nodes.label: No Public Links
nodes.title: No Public Links
nodes.info: A sharing link set to 'anyone with the link' can spread far beyond the two or three people it was meant for. The risk closed: a forwarded link that becomes a public roster.

nodes.label: Use Club Accounts
nodes.title: Use Club Accounts
nodes.info: Data stored in a personal account leaves the club the moment that mentor does. The risk closed: losing the attendance history because one volunteer moved away.

nodes.label: Ask Before Posting
nodes.title: Ask Before Posting
nodes.info: A name or photo posted publicly without asking undoes every other privacy practice in one step. The risk closed: a well-meaning celebration post that identifies a child whose family did not consent.
